svg.title: Tenant-aware MCP solution — Azure component architecture
svg.desc: Deployed personal-tenant proof showing Microsoft Entra ID, hub-and-spoke VNets, Azure AI Foundry, an internal Nginx inference gateway, a private MCP broker, per-customer ACA Sandboxes, Azure Container Registry, and Azure Monitor.
svg.text: Tenant-Aware MCP Solution — Azure Component Architecture
Deployed personal-tenant proof · hub-and-spoke VNets · private MCP broker with per-customer Sandbox isolation

RESOURCE GROUP ss-agent-personal-vnets · Subscription 90babfb4-0fe2-… · centralus · Terraform hub-spoke (Hub · Agent · Tools · Shared VNets, peered · private DNS linked)
AIServices · local auth disabled · agent VNet injection
Activates the VNet / DataProxy tool path
② all model inference → Nginx gateway
ALL model inference → Foundry account (private endpoint)
Validate RS256 token · scope · tenant → SHA256(tid:oid) → customer route
Resolve server-side route · inject per-route bearer key (never to model)
identity: broker-id (UAMI) · secrets: entitlements + python/browser tokens

Allowlisted web egress (per segment) → craigslist.org hosts only · default-deny
